items.t: Lighting wiring harness can short and start a fire (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 10V-388. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.
Free under the brake light switch recall. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Headliner plate can come loose when the curtain airbag deploys (recall)
items.job: Secure headliner plates with adhesive strips
items.note: Free under recall 14V-822. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Clunk in the steering from a worn coupler
ABS control unit can short and catch fire (recall)
items.note: ABS recalls cover affected cars; the fix is often just a new fuse. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Overheated catalytic converter can damage the engine (recall)
items.note: Recall covers software and repairs on affected cars. If the engine was damaged, replacement costs much more.
Kia's extended engine warranty may cover this. Keep oil-change records and check the VIN.
The recall covers inspection, software and engine repair if needed. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Accelerator pedal can bend or break (recall)
items.note: The recall fix adds a support pad under the pedal stopper and is free. Check the VIN.
Recall 17V-608 is free; many cars only need the pinion plug secured. Alignment needed after a gear swap.
Free under recall 22V-096. If the control unit must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Airbag control unit cover can disable the airbags (recall)
items.note: Recall 22V-031 covers this; some cars only need software. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Piston ring defect causing oil burning and engine damage (recall)
items.note: The recall covers inspection and engine replacement if needed. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Theft risk on key-start models without an immobilizer
items.note: Free at Kia dealers; some cars get an ignition guard instead. Fixing a damaged ignition costs extra.

items.t: Transmission oil pump controller can overheat and burn (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-531. Park outside until it is repaired.
Free under recall 23V-298. Check the VIN with a Kia dealer.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may deploy unexpectedly (recall)
items.job: Replace both side curtain airbag modules
items.note: Free under recall 23V-830. Price is for both sides.

items.t: 2.0L engine can burn oil, knock and fail
items.note: Some cars are covered by a Kia engine campaign or extended warranty; have the VIN checked.

items.t: IVT automatic hesitates, slips or loses drive
items.job: Transmission control module reprogram; replace IVT transaxle if needed
items.note: Software update is the first step; the high end is a replacement IVT, often covered by the powertrain warranty.
